titles.romaji: Mahou no Star Magical Emi: Kumo Hikaru
titles.native: 魔法のスターマジカルエミ 雲光る

description: In this 15-minute short story, released more than 15 years after the finale of the popular Mahou no Star Magical Emi franchise, a new life was born into the Kazuki family. How did her baby brother change the family's life and what are Mai's feelings about him. At the end of an eventful day for the siblings and Shou, another concert is waiting for Emi.
